description: This file contains the implementation of an AWS partition class, providing methods to manage AWS endpoint configurations for different regions and services.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Implements AWS partition logic, managing regions, endpoints, and related data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Partition object with a definition array containing partition details.

methods.name: getDnsSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix associated with the partition.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Checks if a given region and service match the partition's criteria.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available endpoints for a specified service, optionally including non-regional endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Generates endpoint data based on input arguments, including URL, signature version, and signing region.

methods.name: getEndpointData
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint configuration data for a specific service and region.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Determines the signature version to use based on endpoint data.

methods.name: resolveRegion
methods.description: Determines the effective region for endpoints, considering global and legacy endpoints.

methods.name: isServicePartitionGlobal
methods.description: Checks if a service is partition-wide and not region-specific.

methods.name: isStsLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a legacy STS endpoint should be used based on options.

methods.name: isS3LegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a legacy S3 endpoint is used for us-east-1 region based on options.

methods.name: getPartitionEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the partition endpoint for a given service.

methods.name: formatEndpoint
methods.description: Formats an endpoint URL based on a template and parameters.

methods.name: isFipsEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a FIPS endpoint is used based on the region string.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Determines the endpoint variant configuration based on options such as FIPS and dual-stack.
